verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own deletion capability: the Storage API can delete files, and the CLI can manage rows, files and users (which implies delete operations). Nothing in the evidence shows retention controls such as TTLs, automatic expiry, retention policies or account/data purge workflows. Missing for 10: configurable data retention policies or TTL/auto-expiry, documented user/account data erasure workflows, logs/backup retention settings, independent corroboration.
